summary: Plymouth County, MA: a 60-ft steel tower on Manomet Hill from 1942, replaced by a Pine Hill tower in 1966; registers disagree on the last staffed year and on the tower's origin.

facts.status_note: Pine Hill tower replaced it in 1966 per three sources, and the Forest Lookouts page says duties moved there; no source describes what remains on Manomet Hill
facts.agency: Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control

events.note: Tower Site #4 record: first operated in 1942
New 60-foot tower erected on Manomet Hill; duties transferred from Telegraph Hill. The Manomet Hill record instead says the tower was relocated from Pelham
Duties moved to the new tower on Pine Hill, built in 1966 (Forest Lookouts); the Pine Hill register says the Manomet Hill tower served there until 1966
Manomet Hill record: in use until about 1966
Tower Site #4 record gives 1968; the other records give 1966 (disputed)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Tower Site #4 says the tower was staffed until 1968. The Manomet Hill record says it was in use until about 1966, the Pine Hill register says the tower served there until 1966, while the Forest Lookouts page says duties moved to the Pine Hill tower in 1966. The story uses 1966 and notes the 1968 date.

The Manomet Hill record says the 60-foot tower was relocated from Pelham. The Pine Hill register and Forest Lookouts say a new tower was constructed in 1942, with duties transferred from Telegraph Hill. Not resolved; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two FFLOS entries cover this spot: Tower Site #4 (US 16, registered 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg) and Plymouth (Manomet Hill) Fire Tower Site (US 1548, MA 55, registered March 27, 2014, nominated by Ed Post). Coordinates differ by under 0.1 arc-minute; consider merging. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post describes remnants found on Manomet Hill, but the page did not load through fetch_text, so it is not cited. No visit report, access information or photo found.
